purpose: Executable llama.cpp recipes used to reproduce every public gallery number. Each recipe names the source lane (miniv-router INI / miniv-lanes / start-server-v2.sh harness / flash-next campaign). Recipes are starting points measured on the Corsair AI Workstation 300 (AMD Ryzen AI MAX 385, Radeon 8050S, 64GB LPDDR5X UMA), not universal quality scores.
backend_note: All command recipes are written for the llama-cpp-turboquant Vulkan fork (build b9677-4595fff0b). The TurboQuant KV-cache types (turbo4/turbo3) and --fit/--lazy-mode/--load-mode flags are fork-specific. Each recipe also lists an upstream_equivalent that replaces turbo4/turbo3 with --cache-type-k q8_0 --cache-type-v q8_0 and drops the fork-only flags so the same measurements can be reproduced on vanilla llama.cpp. Adjust -ngl 99 (full GPU offload) and -t 7 to your hardware.
harness_note: Bench v2.2 models were served through benchmarks/start-server-v2.sh, which sets per-family sampling (qwen: temp 1.0, presence-penalty 0.2; gemma: temp 1.0, top-k 64), DRY repetition penalty, YaRN rope scaling beyond 32K context, and n-gram speculative decoding for non-MTP models. The 'command' recipe above shows the equivalent llama-server invocation; both produce identical metrics when seed is fixed.
